snippet.title: Harrowed World: What's Past Is Portents – Duncan's Story Release Date Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
___________________________WISHLIST NOW________________________________
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3042100/Harrowed_World_Whats_Past_Is_Portents__Story_Pack/

You are Dr Duncan Richard Edwin-Oswald, a renowned physician, a gentleman, and a kind-hearted philanthropist. 

Cursed by guilt and consumed by grief, you consider taking drastic measures, when you are visited by a mysterious woman who is not all that she seems.

Duncan's Story is the premiere tale in the Story Pack DLC for 'Harrowed World: What's Past Is Portents', Our Gothic Vampire Visual Novel. The remaining stories will be made available as future updates at no extra charge to owners of the Story Pack.

____________________________________________________________________________

Subscribe to the newsletter: https://www.harrowedworld.com/newsletter

Harrowed World is a fictional setting and all stories set within are fictious. Names, characters, businesses, websites, events, and incidents are the products of the author’s imagination. Any resemblance to actual persons, living or dead, or actual events, businesses or websites is purely coincidental and not intended by the author. Certain long-standing institutions, agencies, and public offices may be mentioned, but the characters involved are wholly imaginary and these groups are not meant to accurately represent their real-world counterparts.
